capabilities: Run any command in a terminal tile
Restore tiles and agent conversations after a restart
Let coding agents open, fork and write to tiles
Stop all running programs from the command palette
disambiguation: Not a life-science or plant tracker; the tiles are terminals, web pages and running programs.
extras: Not in the community plugin directory; built from source. macOS and Linux only, no Windows or mobile support. Installs files outside the vault (tmux server, ~/.vivarium, agent skills) and lists them in the README; tile files store commands and URLs, so secrets should not be put in them.
motivation: Built for personal use, with the priority on getting a working prototype done quickly.
problem: Notes and canvas cards are static, so terminals, dev servers and coding agents run in separate windows away from the notes they belong to.

relations.evidence: Claude Code and Codex tiles resume their own conversation.

summary: Canvas tiles that run terminals, coding agents, dev servers and web pages, kept alive in tmux after Obsidian closes.
